dedupe_keys.name: liechtenstein office of statistics etab pxweb tables on buildings and dwellings including detailed results for 2010 2015 and 2020 by construction period heating type heating energy source and municipality and annual building counts since 1980

description: The Office of Statistics of Liechtenstein publishes its building and dwelling statistics in the eTab PxWeb portal, which has an open JSON API. The detailed results section holds tables at the reference dates 31 December 2010, 2015 and 2020. Table 391.204d counts buildings by construction period, heating type and heating energy source in each of the 11 municipalities. Heating types include public district heating and central heating for several buildings, and energy sources include heating oil, gas, electricity, wood, heat pumps, district heat and solar collectors. Other detailed tables give buildings by storeys, dwelling units, owner type and renovation period, and dwellings by rooms, floor area and occupancy. Annual tables add building counts since 1980, heating energy by construction period up to 2025, and building permits and costs since 2010. Coverage is national. Format and access: free tables through the portal and as PX or JSON through the PxWeb API, no registration. Licence: not stated on the eTab pages read. Caveats: labels are in German; the main statistics portal is behind a bot check from the cloud. Simulation uses: heating technology stock by age and municipality for heat pump and district heating planning. Related records: the swissBUILDINGS3D building model, which covers Liechtenstein.
